final_message: I parsed the log file workspace/app.log by reading each entry and filtering only those with level ERROR or CRITICAL (case insensitive). I converted the timestamps to UTC in the required format, extracted the service, level (uppercased), message (text after service: on the first line), and the last line of any traceback as the exception (or null if none). I also accounted for repeated messages by summing the repeat counts from the "-- last message repeated N times --" lines following each entry. Finally, I aggregated counts by service and wrote the structured JSON output to workspace/errors.json following the Acme log-triage conventions.
